_meta.note: A journey is either an entry of the curated trip index (derivedFrom gyuj-collections; label verbatim) or a run of dated records (derivedFrom date-gap). Stops are where records were made, or, for index entries without online records, the places named in the label. Travel between stops, the departure point and the return are inferred and labelled as such.
